As always, shipping is way faster than advertized! This log cart is sturdy, takes 15 minutes to assemble and was pleasently surprised by the quality. Carried logs from the back.of the house to the spliter, 100 feet away. Easy peasy. Definitly recommend.

The basic construction is good, but needs improvement. Overall, a good value for money. You need a 12 mm wrench for the screw and a 14 mm wrench for the nut. The wheels are the right size, they provide easy movement, and they have good stair climbing ability. The 500 mm max width fits into small spaces. The welds are of varying quality. The cart loading surface is 300 mm wide. This is too wide for me, so I will modify it and improve it by installing a steel grid. If the manufacturer had installed this element, it would be an excellent tool, but now only 4 stars.
Kjøpte denne for å bruke til laste apparatet til en gammel traktor. Virker veldig greit. Mangler enda noen koblinger og slanger for å få det i drift, men med denne enheten burde det gå greit.
Semplice, essenziale, funziona perfettamente. Ottimo per l'uso domestico.
